name: comp-453
title: Breadcrumb Select Dropdown
description: A path starting at Databases whose next crumb is a dropdown showing a database glyph and the chosen name; opening it lists Orion, Sigma and Dorado with a tick on the current one.
use: Letting people jump between sibling records while keeping the parent path visible.
avoid: When the choice is long: the menu holds only three hardcoded databases.
a11y: The trigger has an aria-label and a proper option list, and focus is visible; no reduced-motion handling for the menu. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The grey word Databases and a chevron lead to a rounded outlined control holding a small database icon, a name and a down arrow. Opening it shows a dark rounded menu of three names with the active one ticked at the right.
behaves: Clicking the control drops the list beneath; hovering a name fills that row grey and choosing one updates the control's label. A check mark stays with the current choice.
customise: The parent crumb, icon, three options and default value are written inside; real data means editing the select items. Trigger padding and width are classes.
weight: light: One small select and a short menu; only light open and hover transitions.
